item.description: Sparks, the legendary US art pop duo, return to Australia for headline shows in Melbourne and Brisbane, plus a Vivid Live appearance at Sydney Opera House

item.description: Don McLean returns to Australia this October to celebrate 55 years of American Pie with a national tour.

item.title: Resonate Program Opens Applications For 2026 Indigenous Songwriters And Producers
item.description: APRA AMCOS launches the 2026 Resonate initiative, bringing leading Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander artists together in Brisbane for an intensive creative exchange by Paul Cashmere Applications have opened for the 2026 Resonate program, with APRA AMCOS again offering a significant platform for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander songwriters and producers to develop their craft

item.title: Stephen Cummings Announces Joy EP And Rare Melbourne Show With New Video Release
